name: IC Analog — I2C — QFN
description: Surface-mount analog IC cluster featuring I2C communication interface in 24-pin QFN packages with an exposed pad.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an analog IC, such as a DAC or ADC, with an I2C interface.
Verify the exposed pad footprint dimension between EP 2.6x2.6mm and EP 2.7x2.7mm.
Ensure assembly capabilities support surface-mount 24-pin QFN packages with 0.5mm pitch.
avoid_when: Designs requiring through-hole mounting instead of surface-mount components.
Applications requiring bus or communication interfaces other than I2C.
Board designs requiring package footprints other than 24-pin 4x4mm QFN.
